blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — NBA deputy commissioner Mark Tatum said the Philippines remains part of the league’s plans, although a game in the country is not an immediate priority. During an online press conference with global media on Tuesday night, Tatum outlined the NBA’s continued efforts in the Philippines, including grassroots programs and fan events. READ: NBA opens season with 125 international players on rosters “Games in the Philippines are not on the immediate docket,” said Tatum. “[But] we’re going to continue to engage with our tens of millions of fans in the Philippines.
